title: Maximum Sum of Two Non-Overlapping Subarrays
description: Find the maximum sum of two non-overlapping subarrays with lengths L and M.
pseudocode:
1. compute prefix sums
2. maxSum(L, M) helper: tracks max L-sum seen so far
3. slide L then M, then slide M then L
4. return max of both cases

steps.note: Initialize prefix sums for array [0, 6, 5, 2, 2, 5, 1, 9, 4], L=1, M=2
Slide window M=2 after L=1, current sum L+M = 6 + (5+2) = 13
Slide window M=2, current sum L+M = 6 + (2+2) = 10
Final max calculated across all non-overlapping windows is 20 (from 9+4 and 5+2)
